class.6:
End of speed limit (80kmh)

Cancels the action of the sign 3.24 "Maximum speed limit". A yellow background means that this sign is temporary. In addition, signs mounted on portable supports are considered temporary. (The changes came into force on March 1, 2023.) In cases where the values of temporary road signs and stationary road signs contradict each other, drivers should be guided by temporary signs.

class.9:
No passing

This Sign is a traffic sign that indicates areas where passing or overtaking other vehicles is prohibited. Typically, this sign is characterized by a horizontal rectangle with a white background and black diagonal stripes.
class.10:
No passing for vehicles over 3.5 metric tons

No passing for vehicles over 3.5 metric tons prohibits overtaking in the area located behind the sign only by trucks with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons. Therefore, by driving the bus, you can overtake.
class.11:
Right-of-way at the next intersectionn

Grants the right of preferential passage of an unregulated intersection to vehicles located on the main road. It is installed directly in front of the intersection, where overtaking is allowed on the main road in relation to the one being crossed.
class.12:
Priority road

Drivers who drive on this road have an advantage at all unregulated intersections.
class.13:
Yield

The driver must stop at the intersection in order to give way to vehicles moving along the main road.
class.14:
Stop

It is prohibited to move without stopping in front of the stop line, and if there is no stop line, in front of the edge of the intersected carriageway. The driver must give way to vehicles moving along the intersected road, and if there is a sign 8.13 - on the main road. The 2.5 sign can be installed in front of a railway crossing or quarantine post. In these cases, the driver must stop in front of the stop line, and if there is no stop line, in front of the sign.
class.15:
No vehicles

Prohibits the movement of vehicles on a certain section, with the exception of minibuses and trucks. This road sign is installed at the entrance to pedestrian and park areas, as well as during long-term road repair work.
class.16:
Vehicles over 3.5 metric tons prohibited

Prohibits the movement of trucks and convoys of vehicles with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, self-propelled vehicles and tractors. The maximum allowed weight of the truck may be different, but it must be indicated on the sign.
class.17:
No entry

Restricts entry to a certain part of the roadway for all vehicles, with the exception of shuttle buses and taxis. It is installed at the entrance to one-way streets, as well as on roads with a specially designated public transport lane.
class.18:
General caution

It is used to indicate dangerous situations that are not provided for by other safety measures, and is used together with an explanatory inscription.
class.19:
Dangerous curve to the left

Warns of a dangerous turn. A dangerous turn is a rounding of the road. The smaller the turning radius, the more dangerous the turn itself is, because as the radius decreases, the straight line of the road goes more to the side. At the same time, a dangerous turn can be both with limited visibility and with normal visibility and be clearly visible.
class.20:
Dangerous curve to the right

Warns of a dangerous turn. A dangerous turn is a rounding of the road. The smaller the turning radius, the more dangerous the turn itself is, because as the radius decreases, the straight line of the road goes more to the side. At the same time, a dangerous turn can be both with limited visibility and with normal visibility and be clearly visible.
class.21:
Double curve

Warns drivers about approaching a section of road with dangerous turns.
class.22:
Bumpy road

Encourages the driver to slow down when approaching various uneven sections of the roadway. It is used as a temporary sign preceding the repair work. Indicates the presence of holes, potholes, ruts along the route of the car.
class.23:
Slippery road

It is used on sections of the roadway with a low level of adhesion to the wheels of vehicles. Such situations can be caused by both weather and climatic factors, as well as other temporary circumstances.When approaching this section of the road, the driver is obliged to reduce speed in advance and limit sudden braking and acceleration in order to avoid skidding, provoking traffic accidents.
class.24:
Road narrows on the right

Warns the driver that there is a narrowing of the road ahead on the right side, so it is necessary to rearrange traffic from the extreme right lane to the left.
class.25:
Road work

A road sign 1.25 is installed in front of a section of road within which any type of work is carried out. If the work is carried out on a sidewalk or bicycle path, then the sign is installed in the case when pedestrians or cyclists are forced to use the roadway for movement.
class.26:
Traffic signals

Indicates the approach to a section of road, pedestrian crossing or intersection where traffic is regulated by a traffic light. It is a schematic representation of a traffic light on a white background with red edging.
class.27:
Pedestrians

Warns the driver that he is approaching a section of road where there is a regulated or unregulated pedestrian crossing. Upon seeing the "Pedestrians" sign, the driver must slow down and be ready to stop at any moment to let a pedestrian pass. Such a road sign is most often installed on high-speed sections or in small settlements, where the driver must be warned that there is a pedestrian crossing ahead.
class.28:
Children crossing

Warns drivers about approaching a section of road located near a children's institution.
class.29:
Bicycles crossing

The 1.24 sign warns the driver that he is approaching a section of road where a bicycle path crosses the roadway.
class.30:
Beware of ice/snow

A section of road where snow drifts are possible, or ice or snow-ice formations. It is installed outside populated areas at a distance of 150 to 300 meters, and in populated areas, as a rule, at a distance of 50 to 100 meters before the start of a dangerous section of road.
class.31:
Wild animals crossing

This sign warns the road user about the possible sudden appearance of wild animals on the roadway. As a rule, it is installed near nature reserves, sanctuaries or just in a forest area rich in wild animals.
class.32:
End of all speed and passing limits

Sign 3.31 cancels all restrictions, regardless of their number, which were previously introduced by prohibiting signs. It is installed: In places where the zone of action of forbidding signs ends.
class.33:
Turn right ahead

The sign does not apply to vehicles moving along established routes. The sign applies to the intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed.
class.34:
Turn left ahead

The sign allows movement only to the left. The sign also allows vehicles to turn around. The sign does not apply to vehicles moving along established routes. The sign applies to the intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed.
class.35:
Ahead only

The sign does not apply to vehicles moving along established routes. The sign applies to the intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed. If the sign is installed at the beginning of the road or behind the intersection, its effect extends to the section of road to the nearest intersection. The sign does not prohibit turning right into courtyards and other territories adjacent to the road.
class.36:
Go straight or right

The sign only allows traffic to go straight or to the right. The sign does not apply to vehicles moving along established routes. The sign applies to the intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed.
class.37:
Go straight or left

The sign only allows traffic to go straight or to the left. The sign also allows vehicles to turn around. The sign does not apply to vehicles moving along established routes. The sign applies to the intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed.
class.38:
Keep right

Road sign 4.2.1 instructs drivers to avoid an obstacle from exactly the side indicated by the sign (only on the right).
class.39:
Keep left

The road sign 4.2.2 "Detour of an obstacle on the left" is installed in situations where the usual passage in the right lane is impossible due to an obstacle in the lane, repair work, etc. The pointer is mounted at the beginning of the road barriers, to bypass the islands of safety and other obstacles on the roadway.
class.40:
Roundabout mandatory

Road sign 4.3 is located at the entrances to the roundabout. This safety tool informs motorists about several important rules that must be followed in this case:
- Traffic on this section of the road is carried out only counterclockwise. If the driver needs to turn around, this maneuver can be performed by driving around the entire intersection in a circle.
- You can enter the roundabout from any of the lanes, passing cars on the right.
- It is mandatory to use only the right turn indicators at the entrance to the roundabout.
- The priority of movement is given to those cars that move in a circle. Those entering the intersection must give way to them.
class.42:
End of no passing by vehicles over 3.5 metric tons

The sign prohibits trucks with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons from overtaking all vehicles (except single ones moving at a speed of less than 30 km/h). Tractors are prohibited from overtaking all vehicles except single bicycles, horse-drawn carts (sleds).
The area of operation of the sign is from the installation site to the nearest intersection behind it, and in settlements where there are no intersections — to the end of the settlement. The action of the sign is not interrupted at the exit points from the territories adjacent to the road and at the intersection (junction) with field, forest and other unpaved roads, in front of which priority signs are not installed.
The zone of operation of the sign can be reduced by installing at the end of its zone of operation the sign 3.28 3.28 "End of no passing by vehicles over 3.5 metric tons".
